attack_techniques: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Bypass User Account Control (T1548.002)
attackers_goals: Gain higher privileges by bypassing the User Account Control (UAC).
description: EnableLUA specifies whether Windows User Account Controls (UAC) notifies the user when programs try to modify the computer. UAC was formerly known as Limited User Account (LUA).
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Tampering with the Windows User Account Controls (UAC) configuration
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
